data.name: Visnu
data.gender_notes: Visnu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The sustainer of the universe, the preserver of the law of dharma. The name Visnu carries the meaning “The Preserver” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Telugu. Parents who choose Visnu usually hope their child will grow to embody the preserver and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the power of preservation, protection, and sustenance. The embodiment of love, compassion, and purity.
data.etymology: Visnu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Preserver.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Visnu total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Visnu" holds immense cultural significance in the Hindu tradition as it represents the deity Visnu, one of the most revered and widely worshipped gods of the Hindu pantheon. Visnu is believed to be the preserver of the universe and sustainer of life, order, and dharma. He is often depicted as having four arms, carrying symbols of power such as the conch shell, discus, lotus flower, and mace. The episodes from the Hindu epic Mahabharata and the Hindu Puranas, and various legends and folktales, have deeply etched the stories and propagated the importance of Visnu and his name in Hindu culture.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name "Visnu" signifies the divine force that preserves and governs the universe. It is a reminder of the principle of dharma, the underlying law of the universe, which sustains all existence. The name evokes a sense of peace, security, and order, reminding us of the divine protective force that is always present and preserving the delicate balance of existence. Through devotion, chanting of Visnu's name, or merely acknowledging the presence of this divine force in our lives, we can tap into the spiritual significance and peace that comes with the name "Visnu."
data.spiritual_symbolism: Visnu is the preserver and sustainer in the Hindu Trimurti, symbolizing the eternal balance and continuity in the universe. He embodies love, protection, and nourishment, ensuring the cosmic order and dharma remain intact.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Lakshmi Visnu in Hyderabad, India attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Visnu, which means "The Preserver". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.
